title: Two Pizzas Once Cost 10,000 Bitcoins in 2010

scenes.text: Two pizzas once cost ten thousand bitcoins.
May 22, 2010. A programmer posts an offer online.
A volunteer in the UK orders two Papa John's pizzas for him.
The bitcoins were worth about forty dollars back then.
Fans now celebrate every May 22 as Bitcoin Pizza Day.
Forty dollars of coins for two pizzas. Pizza or coins, which would you take?

description:
Two pizzas once cost ten thousand bitcoins.
On May 22, 2010, a programmer offered 10,000 bitcoins, worth about 40 dollars then, and a UK volunteer ordered him two Papa John's pizzas. The date is now known as Bitcoin Pizza Day.
Pizza or coins? Comment below.
first_comment: This is a history fact, not advice. Would you have spent them on pizza?
